author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a rope hank on the source's diagonal, two round loops tied at the waist by a binding with two wrapped bands; point-symmetric about the centre. A version with a plain binding and circle loops was rejected because it read as a chain link.
omissions: The source draws the rope as a double outline (thick rope) with three wrap bands; at 48px the rope is a single stroke and the binding keeps two bands, the most that stay 8 units open.
drawing_plan: Rotated binding p=+-6, q=+-5 about (24,24) with one wrap line; mirrored cubic loops with knots at the keyshape extremes.
lucide_reference: No rope glyph in Lucide; 45-degree straight runs as in diamond, round cubic loops.
